name: java-developer
description: Maven project setup for Claude Code, secret protection, automatic checks and a single task workflow for Java teams, with a report on request (PR description, QA handoff, self-review, session note)

pr.title: PR description
pr.description: In every report, pr.md: the PR title `<TICKET> <summary>` and description from the team template - what and why, how it was tested, notes for reviewers, scope and merge order.

qa_handoff.title: QA handoff
qa_handoff.description: In every report, qa-handoff.md: what changed in product words, how to test it (checks from the spec's acceptance criteria, test data), areas to retest, and a comment ready to paste into the Jira ticket for QA.

review.title: Self-review
review.description: In every report, review.md: the java-reviewer report on the branch against the base branch and the team checklist, with a verdict, before the PR.

summary.title: Session note
summary.description: In every report, save a session note to the Obsidian vault through session-summary: what was done, decisions, a mermaid summary.
